description.value:
Prerequisites: White Mage 4, Lay on Hands class feature, Worship Good Deity, Must be Good-Aligned

The white mage gains the supernatural ability to channel holy energy like a good-aligned cleric. Using this ability consumes two users of her lay on hands ability. A white mage uses her level as her effective cleric level when channeling holy energy. This is a Charisma-based ability.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - White Mage (Mage Talents)
